Admissions · 2026–27

From enquiry to the first day

Applications are open across all key stages. Start below — the whole journey is four calm steps, starting with a form that takes about five minutes.

Start the application → Book a visit

The journey

Four steps, each one friendly

  1. 01

    Enquire

    Ask us anything by phone, WhatsApp or the short form below. We answer within a working day.

  2. 02

    Apply

    Complete the online application — about five minutes, three short screens.

  3. 03

    Assess

    A short, friendly assessment and interview with Admissions — no pressure, just fit.

  4. 04

    Offer

    Welcome letter, fees letter, onboarding schedule — then the first day.

What you need

Everything to prepare before you start

A completed application form, the child’s birth certificate and two passport-size photographs. For transfers: the most recent school reports, plus any exam slips for older students.

Nursery & Early Years from age 2; Primary (KS1–2) from age 5; Junior Secondary (KS3) from age 11; Senior Secondary (KS4+) from age 14. Class placement is confirmed by the academic office after assessment.

A short age-appropriate assessment and an interview with the Admissions team. It is about fit, not a pass/fail gate — we find the right class for the child, not the other way round.

Boarding is available for Junior and Senior pupils. Families applying for boarding also share a brief note on the child’s routine and any medical needs — the house staff read it before day one.

We accept enquiries all year. For the 2026–27 session, we recommend applying before the term opens on 14 September 2026. Term dates are shared with families by the school office.
